title: Lunch with Stubblebine about Buchanan's clearance

tellings.quote: >> Bert and I were out at at lunch and he said, "What is your clearance?"

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, an Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he was out at lunch with Albert Stubblebine, an Army general he calls Bert, when the general asked him straight out: "What is your clearance?" Buchanan tells this first-hand to Michels as the moment that drew him into secret work beyond his security level, the kind of work that led him to say he once operated a UFO with his mind.
